reviews.x: My son is an adorable 2yr old, who is mixed and has beautiful curly hair, and he's autistic as well.  My son (probably like most kids at first) hates going to the barber.  However I would say most of it is because he was also born with a disease that has required a couple surgeries and very unpleasant visits to the doctor, I think the trauma from having things done to him at the hospital is more than likely his reason to not like getting his hair cut, because he doesn't like other people near hi

reviews.t: There are 2 attachments that cut really close - like a buzz cut - very short
reviews.x: I use this on my 2 year old son.  It is very quiet and does not scare him at all.  There are 2 attachments that cut really close - like a buzz cut - very short.  I do the bottom part of his head that way.  There is a bit of a learning curve to figure out how to cut the rest of the hair - the top of his head - with a longer cut. reviews.x: This clipper is quiet as to why u gave it a one star. But my 3 year old hates it because it has nicked him a few times already. It did not come with a charger.  Barely, a year has past and the clippers charge light is on but the clipper does not turn on or work.

My 3 year old boy is on the autism spectrum and sense he was one year old I only give him 3 to 5 hair cuts a year. He is afraid of the sound, hair falling and feeling. This product is great idea minimum sound and small to hold with one hand. Presentation of packaging is great. I give it 4 stars because it states water proof. After reading the instructions It says washable, not submersible. I wanted to go in the shower and cut his hair. I still give it a try, but as soon as he saw the clippers he

reviews.t: Great for a child with Autism!!!
reviews.x: Fantastic!! Our son has Autism and hair cuts are very difficult for him. This clipper is extremely quiet and the vibration is very mild. The sound and vibration is what is hard for our son to handle. I would recommend this product for anyone with a child with Autism, sensory disorder or even just a child who struggles with hair cuts! I love the guards that come with it cause you can't screw up the length or cut the child. Very safe. Definitely buying again!

Love love these kids clippers I always cut my son hair when he's sleeping and he doesn't even notice.they are really quite and yes water proof but don't soak them! I would only say and stress to mothers and fathers if you do not know how to cut hair please do not use because you may not have a good experience.

To my surprise I did this crew cut ALL BY MYSELF.  He sat there and at one point said it tickled!  He loved the fish on the front and was proud that it was his own. My issue is though, when I open the manual to see what accessories are what, I noticed that STANDARD ACCESSORIES are showing a lot more options than what I have in my box. So I was happy, until I opened the manual and noticed I'm not getting everything that is listed in the manual.. so I'm annoyed.

It's very quiet and it's actually waterproof. The only thing I did not like is that it left some patches on my sons hair and at the end I had to cut all of it so It can grow back the same length. I rather just pay and take him to get his hair done without having patches. Now my poor baby is bald :(
I had this product for last few years suddenly blade inside is broken but i use it once in 6 months for my kid not often, could you please let me know what would be the reason what should I do?

reviews.t: Effective for the job, may still be scary to young children though
reviews.x: This arrived packaged as another reviewer depicted in a picture. I was able to use the trimmer immediately after opening it. I watched a few YouTube videos on how to give a buzz cut and set off. My son was not in a mood for a haircut at the time after having just got back from out of state so it was a bit of a challenge. It was as if he was hula hooping with his upper body without the hoola hoop.  Halfway through the cut I felt the need to plug in the trimmer to see if it would have more power.

reviews.t: Very Quiet.  Great for children on the autism spectrum or sensitive to noise
reviews.x: I purchased this as I don't see a need to pay $15 for a buzz cut for three boys. Needless to say this has paid for itself in less than 3 haircuts.  The cuts are nice and even and even I cold do it pretty well. It also came with all the sizes I needed for each of my boys. Clean up was also very simple.  The nice thing with this device is how quiet it was.  My 5 year and 7 year old both have autism and can't stand getting their hair cut. This unit was so quiet they barely fused.  That alone made i

reviews.x: This thing is life in a box. My nephew hates any kind of shaver that gets close to him. All our other shavers sound like lawn mowers compared to this! Its so amazing and quiet. He wasnt scared and let me cut him hair in no time. And you can use it when they shower. I used it to try and make a good straight line. reviews.t: The produce works good at the beginning
reviews.x: The produce works good at the beginning, however after around 20 times use, it can’t be charged. Now it sleeps in my drawer, and useless.

reviews.t: Better off with a regular retail product!

I'm a first time mom who has never used clippers before. My 5 month old son's hair was growing in patches and several barber shops in the area refused to shave his head. I was worried that my son would be afraid of the noise but it was quiet and gentle. These clippers worked great! He looked like a cute Shaolin monk baby but his hair is growing in nicely now.

Had this for approximately 8 months and it stopped working. I put it to charge so I could cut my son's hair. Took it off the charger, pressed the power button and nothing happened. I was so shocked. I expected to get at least 2 years of use out of this product because I only use it about once every 2 months. I'm very disappointed.

reviews.t: Horrible product - my son is scared of it moment ...
reviews.x: Horrible product - my son is scared of it moment I turn it on. It was suppose to be noise free which it is not. It makes so much noise that my son wakes up from his sleep just with the sound of it. I want to return this product as it is useless - my son does not allow me to trim his hair as he is so scared of this noise.

reviews.t: Highly recommend. Only wish the user manual could be more ...
reviews.x: Works well on a two-month baby for the first haircut. Highly recommend. Only wish the user manual could be more specific, not just one for many different models the company makes. As an example, the section on how to clean it after use cannot be applied to this particular model at all.

Functional hair clipper! It is a good design for children. there are 2 settable combs with four lengths. It won’t hurt my kid, he seems like this little “toy”. My wife did a good job! Wonderful, she loves it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clipper for being very quiet, which helps children who are sensitive to noise or on the autism spectrum.
Many parents say it works well for children with autism or sensory sensitivities, making haircuts easier at home.
Some reviewers report durability problems, including the clipper failing to charge or turn on after a period of use.
A few reviewers mention issues with the cut quality, such as leaving patches or nicking the child.
Some reviewers note missing accessories or receiving a used/incomplete item.
